name: Sales Club at USC
description: Sales Club at USC is the premier undergraduate student organization dedicated to developing world-class sales professionals. Our mission is to equip USC students with the practical skills, mindset, and professional network required to excel in sales, business development, account management, and revenue-generating roles across all industries. Through hands-on workshops, real-world case studies, guest speaker events, and mock sales pitches, we seek to bridge the gap between classroom theory and high-impact sales careers.

name: SAP Association
description: SAP Association is devoted to providing additional resources for students interested in enterprise information systems. Through speaker events, workshops, and case studies, our club is committed to preparing its members for their future careers in SAP.
